pp_desc: Add each person when they join. Appuscholar gives them a code and looks for their name in your data, documents and AI requests.
pp_sealed: Sealed in your vault: only you can open it
pp_no_project: Open a project to see its participants.
pp_off: Set up your vault first: your participant list is only ever stored sealed.
pp_broken: Your participant list does not open on this device.
pp_error: Could not read your participant list.
pp_save_failed: Not saved yet. Appuscholar will try again.
pp_cannot_save: Could not save this change. Try again.
pp_read_only: You can change the list in the Collection and analysis window.
pp_anonymous: Your plan says this study is anonymous, so no list is kept. If that changes, change it in {link}.
pp_plan_mode_pseudonyms: participants are known by made-up names.
pp_plan_unanswered: Not answered yet in your plan.
pp_plan_unread: Could not read your plan in Design and ethics.
pp_empty: No one is on your list yet. Add each person when they join, or paste a list.
pp_everyday_mark: also an everyday word: asked before replacing
pp_about_note: Fill the “about them” columns only if they are not already in your data tables.
pp_form_hindi: Add the Hindi spelling if they write their name that way: Appuscholar does not turn one script into the other.
pp_form_everyday_why: Each find of an everyday word is asked about, never replaced in one go.
pp_paste_hint: One person on each line. Put other spellings after a comma, like: Priya Sharma, Priya, प्रिया. A key file from Statistics (appuscholar_key_keep_separate.csv) or a list you downloaded here keeps its codes.
pp_paste_empty: Nothing to add. Put one person on each line.
pp_paste_skipped_code: Skipped {n} whose code is already used: {names}.
pp_anonymous_note_one: Your plan now says anonymous, but a list of 1 person is stored. Destroy the list, or change the plan back.
pp_anonymous_note_many: Your plan now says anonymous, but a list of {n} people is stored. Destroy the list, or change the plan back.
pp_drift_one: {field} is still stored for 1 person, but your plan no longer records it.
pp_drift_many: {field} is still stored for {n} people, but your plan no longer records it.
pp_drift_one_pl: {field} are still stored for 1 person, but your plan no longer records them.
pp_drift_many_pl: {field} are still stored for {n} people, but your plan no longer records them.
pp_withdraw_check: Check what your consent form says you may do with the data of a person who withdraws.
pp_withdraw_done: {code} is marked as withdrawn. Their code is kept.
pp_unwithdraw_done: {code} is no longer marked as withdrawn.
pp_copied: Copied. It has the codes and what you recorded about them, no names.
pp_download_note: This file holds names. Keep it apart from your data.
pp_destroy_desc1: This removes everyone from your list: names, spellings, contact details, roll numbers and what you recorded about them. Appuscholar keeps only the next code number, so a code is never used twice. Download the list first if you need a copy.
pp_destroy_desc2: This cannot be undone. Every name on the list will be gone for good.
pp_destroyed: Your list was destroyed on {date}. New people you add continue from {code}, so a code is never used twice.
pp_find_no_docs: There are no documents to look through.
pp_find_none: No names found in your documents.
pp_find_no_pseudonym: No made-up name yet, so the code is used.
pp_find_refused: Could not change “{title}”. It may have been deleted, or it has changes that are not saved yet. Nothing was changed in it.
pp_find_versions: Earlier saved versions of a document still hold the old text, sealed in your vault.
